goal: Prevent incoming Tor peers from being misclassified by IP and inheriting local IP whitelist permissions
Require a dedicated onion bind at startup when automatic Tor listening runs with explicit bind options
agreement: Unaddressed objection: startup failure for single-bind setups is too harsh versus fallback (sedited)
Supports rejecting wildcard binds because container environments can set dedicated IPs (vasild)
Verified by building and testing on FreeBSD 15.0 with Clang 19 (winterrdog)
Concept approval or general approval without detailed rationale (jeanpablojp, jpk68)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents Tor connections from inheriting permissions meant for local daemon IPs
Inbound Tor peers forwarded to regular or wildcard listeners risk misclassification by IP
